description: Karnataka has introduced an AI skill education curriculum for Class 9 students, covering statistics, calculus, linear algebra and probability.
body_lead: The curriculum will introduce four mathematical areas like statistics, calculus, linear algebra, and probability, through AI-focused modules in government high schools. The Karnataka Department of School Education and Literacy has developed a specialised Artificial Intelligence (AI) curriculum for Class 9 students. This AI curriculum will introduce them to the mathematical principles behind new technologies.
